kpis.name: Schedule Variance (SV)
kpis.description: % deviation of actual progress from planned progress (earned value vs planned value)
kpis.formula: SV = (EV - PV) / PV * 100

kpis.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
kpis.description: Ratio of earned value to actual cost, indicating budget efficiency
kpis.formula: CPI = EV / AC

kpis.name: Procurement Delay Index
kpis.description: Number of long-lead procurement packages delayed by > 30 days as % of total critical packages
kpis.formula: PDI = Delayed critical packages / Total critical packages * 100

kpis.name: Permit Readiness
kpis.description: % of required permits and approvals secured or in final stage for the current phase gate
kpis.formula: PR = Permits obtained + permits in final review / Total permits required * 100

kpis.name: HAZOP Close-out %
kpis.description: % of HAZOP recommendations closed (implemented and verified) vs total
kpis.formula: HCO = Recommendations closed / Total recommendations * 100

kpis.name: Feedstock Security %
kpis.description: % of annual feedstock requirement covered by signed supply agreements or firm commitments
kpis.formula: FSS = Firmly contracted feedstock volume / Annual requirement * 100

kpis.name: Gasifier Availability Target
kpis.description: Actual gasifier operating availability vs design target
kpis.formula: GA = Operating hours / (Operating + forced outage hours) * 100

kpis.name: Syngas Cleanup Readiness
kpis.description: % of syngas cleanup systems commissioned and verified to meet outlet specifications
kpis.formula: SCR = Commissioned cleanup systems / Total cleanup systems * 100

kpis.name: Catalyst Procurement Status
kpis.description: Status of catalyst procurement against schedule (ordered, in-transit, received, loaded)
kpis.target: Green (ordered >12 months before loading, on schedule)
kpis.formula: RAG: ordered on schedule = Green, delayed < 30 days = Amber, delayed > 30 days = Red

kpis.name: Commissioning Readiness
kpis.description: % of pre-commissioning activities completed per approved plan
kpis.formula: CR = Pre-commissioning activities complete / Total planned * 100

kpis.name: Methanol Quality Pass Rate
kpis.description: % of product batches meeting IMPCA specification on first pass
kpis.formula: MQP = On-spec batches / Total batches * 100

kpis.name: Performance Test Completion
kpis.description: Whether the 72-hour performance guarantee test has been completed with all guarantees met
kpis.formula: N/A — binary pass/fail per EPC contract

kpis.name: Change Order Rate
kpis.description: Number of change orders per month and their aggregate cost impact as % of approved budget
kpis.formula: COR = Total change order cost / Approved budget * 100

kpis.name: Safety Performance (LTIF)
kpis.description: Lost time injury frequency per million man-hours worked
kpis.formula: LTIF = Total LTI * 1,000,000 / Total man-hours

kpis.name: Project Cost of Methanol Production
kpis.description: Actual cost per tonne of methanol produced vs target cost of production
kpis.formula: CoP = Total monthly operating cost / Methanol produced (tonnes)

kpis.name: Syngas Stoichiometric Number (SN)
kpis.description: Ratio (H2 - CO2) / (CO + CO2) measured at methanol synthesis inlet
kpis.formula: SN = (H2_mol% - CO2_mol%) / (CO_mol% + CO2_mol%)

kpis.name: Tar Concentration After Cleanup
kpis.description: Gravimetric tar concentration in cleaned syngas before methanol synthesis
kpis.formula: Tar = mass collected / sample volume (standard conditions)

kpis.name: Carbon Efficiency (C in methanol / C in biomass)
kpis.description: Overall carbon conversion efficiency from biomass carbon to methanol carbon
kpis.formula: CE = (Methanol tonnes * C_fraction_methanol) / (Biomass tonnes * C_fraction_biomass) * 100

kpis.name: Plant On-Stream Factor
kpis.description: % of calendar time the plant operates at or above minimum stable rate
kpis.formula: OSF = Operating hours / Calendar hours * 100

kpis.name: Commissioning Schedule Compliance
kpis.description: % of commissioning milestones achieved within ±7 days of baseline schedule
kpis.formula: CSC = Milestones achieved on schedule / Total commissioning milestones * 100

kpis.name: Carbon Intensity (gCO2e/MJ methanol)
kpis.description: Well-to-gate carbon intensity of green methanol product — total lifecycle CO2e emissions per megajoule of methanol produced, verifying the carbon reduction claim relative to fossil methanol
kpis.target: <= baseline target per ISCC/RSB methodology (e.g., < 30 gCO2e/MJ for biomass gasification route)
kpis.formula: Total lifecycle emissions (feedstock, transport, processing) / Total methanol energy output (MJ)
kpis.source: GHG calculation model per ISCC/RSB methodology; verified at certification audit

kpis.name: Biogenic Carbon Share (%)
kpis.description: Percentage of carbon in the final methanol product that is biogenic (from biomass feedstock) rather than fossil-derived — key for carbon accounting and green product claims
kpis.formula: (Biogenic C in product / Total C in product) x 100 — determined by 14C radiocarbon analysis (ASTM D6866)
kpis.source: Radiocarbon analysis lab report; feedstock mass balance records

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Fraction in Process Energy
kpis.description: Share of total process energy demand (power, steam) supplied from renewable sources — critical for overall carbon intensity and sustainability certification
kpis.formula: (Renewable power + renewable steam energy) / (Total process power + total process steam energy) x 100
kpis.source: Utility meters / PPA records / biomass boiler fuel logs

kpis.name: Water Consumption Intensity (m3/t methanol)
kpis.description: Fresh water consumed per tonne of methanol produced — tracking water efficiency improvement and compliance with water abstraction permit limits
kpis.target: <= design target from FEED (typically 3-6 m3/t depending on cooling technology)
kpis.formula: Total fresh water consumption (m3) / Total methanol production (tonnes)
kpis.source: Water meter readings at abstraction points / process water balance model
